_help: Built-in edit presets (read-only; regenerated by scripts/build_presets.ts). Adapted from One Node · FLUX.2 [klein] Discover prompts (github.com/yanokusnir-ai/one-node-flux-2-klein) to Darkroom's preset rules, with separate Klein and Qwen-Image 2.1 wording. Your own presets live in data/user_presets.json and are merged by label.

presets.label: Close-up
presets.klein: Move the camera in to a tight close-up of the subject, cropping close on the main details. Keep every colour, texture and element of the scene identical and sharp, only seen from much closer.
presets.qwen: Show <image1> as a tight close-up of the main subject, cropping in close on its details. Keep all colours, textures and elements of the scene unchanged; only the camera distance changes.

presets.label: Wide-angle
presets.klein: Switch to a wide-angle lens with the subject still at the centre, revealing more of the surrounding environment. Keep the architecture, the lighting and the background identical to the original scene.
presets.qwen: Show <image1> through a wide-angle lens with the subject still at the centre, revealing more of its surroundings. Keep the architecture, the lighting and the existing background unchanged.

presets.label: Aerial view
presets.klein: Move the camera up to a high aerial view looking down on the scene. Keep every landmark, colour and the lighting consistent with the original picture.
presets.qwen: Show the scene of <image1> from a high aerial viewpoint looking down. Keep all landmarks, colours and the lighting consistent with the original.

presets.label: Low-angle
presets.klein: Move the camera down to a low angle near the ground, showing more of the sky or ceiling. Keep the environment identical and keep the subject and background in the same relationship and scale.
presets.qwen: Show <image1> from a low camera angle near the ground, revealing more of the sky or ceiling. Keep the environment unchanged and keep the subject and background at the same scale and in the same arrangement.

presets.label: Enhance
presets.klein: Restore this photograph: remove the blur, noise and compression artefacts and bring back fine, natural detail and sharp focus. Keep the same composition, the same person and likeness, the original colours, contrast and lighting, and the natural skin and fabric texture. Make it look like a clean, sharp original photograph, not a processed one.
presets.qwen: Enhance the overall quality of <image1>: restore fine detail and sharp focus, and remove motion blur, lens blur, noise and compression artefacts. Keep the composition, every face and its likeness, the colours, the lighting and every object exactly as they are, and add nothing new.

presets.label: Text edit
presets.klein: Replace the existing text "[OLD TEXT]" with the new text "[NEW TEXT]". Match the original typography exactly: font, letter shapes, colour, effects and texture, in the same position, scale and alignment. Keep everything else identical.
presets.qwen: In <image1>, replace the text "[OLD TEXT]" with "[NEW TEXT]". Keep the same font, letter shapes, colour, effects, texture, position, size and alignment, and keep everything else unchanged.

presets.label: Try-on
presets.klein: Using image 1 as the person and image 2 as the outfit: dress the person from image 1 in the exact outfit from image 2, with the same style, materials, textures and colours, fitted naturally to their body and to the lighting of image 1. Keep the face, identity, hair, expression, pose, background and camera framing of image 1 identical.
presets.qwen: Dress the person in <image1> in the outfit from <image2>, with the same style, materials, textures and colours, fitted naturally to their body and lit like <image1>. Keep the face, identity, hair, expression, pose, background and framing of <image1> unchanged.

presets.label: Texture transfer
presets.klein: Using image 1 as the subject and shape and image 2 as the material: replace the surface of the subject in image 1 with the exact texture, pattern and material of image 2, following every contour, curve and the lighting of image 1. Keep the shape, the pose and the background of image 1 identical.
presets.qwen: Replace the surface material of the subject in <image1> with the exact texture, pattern and material shown in <image2>, following its contours and the lighting of <image1>. Keep the shape, the pose and the background of <image1> unchanged.
